steps.tx: **Interstitial lung disease** (ILD, diffuse parenchymal disease that scars the interstitium) presents with chronic exertional dyspnoea and dry cough. **Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis** (IPF, fibrosing ILD without known cause) is the classic prototype affecting adults over 60 years, more in men. Onset is insidious over months, with **digital clubbing** and **bibasal fine crackles** (Velcro sound) in most patients. Forced vital capacity falls while ratio is preserved.
steps.say: Interstitial lung disease is diffuse parenchymal disease that scars the interstitium and fills alveoli. Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is the classic prototype and it affects adults over sixty years. Onset is insidious over months and it progresses slowly. Digital clubbing and bibasal fine crackles are common signs and they are classic. Forced vital capacity falls while the ratio is preserved. This pattern is a restrictive pattern and it is important for diagnosis.

steps.tx: **Usual interstitial pneumonia** (UIP, subpleural basal honeycombing) is the hallmark of IPF. **Non specific interstitial pneumonia** (NSIP, uniform ground glass) occurs in connective tissue disease and hypersensitivity. **Organising pneumonia** (OP, migratory consolidations) follows drugs or infections. **Lymphoid interstitial pneumonia** (LIP) links with Sjögren syndrome. **Smoking** is a major risk for IPF and **desquamative interstitial pneumonia** (DIP). **Environmental exposures** (birds, mould, asbestos) cause hypersensitivity and asbestosis.
steps.say: Usual interstitial pneumonia is the hallmark of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and it shows honeycombing. Non specific interstitial pneumonia is uniform ground glass and it occurs in connective tissue disease. Organising pneumonia is migratory consolidation and it follows drugs or infections. Lymphoid interstitial pneumonia links with Sjogren syndrome. Smoking is a major risk for fibrosis and desquamative pattern. Environmental exposures cause hypersensitivity and asbestos related disease and they must be sought.

steps.tx: **Alveolar epithelial injury** (repeated microscopic damage) triggers **fibroblast foci** (active scar) and collagen deposition that stiffens lung and thickens interstitium. Thickened membrane impairs diffusion, especially carbon monoxide, producing **reduced diffusing capacity** (DLCO, gas transfer) with preserved volumes ratio. Hypoxaemia on exertion and **type 1 respiratory failure** (hypoxia with low carbon dioxide) arise. Pulmonary hypertension develops from vascular pruning and hypoxic vasoconstriction.
steps.say: Alveolar epithelial injury is repeated microscopic damage and it triggers fibroblast foci. Collagen deposition is stiffening of the lung and it thickens the interstitium and it impairs diffusion. Thickened membrane is a barrier and it reduces gas transfer markedly. Hypoxaemia on exertion occurs and it indicates severe disease. Type one respiratory failure is hypoxia with low carbon dioxide and it is seen on exertion. Pulmonary hypertension develops from vascular pruning and hypoxic vasoconstriction and it worsens prognosis.

steps.tx: Patients describe **progressive exertional dyspnoea** (breathlessness on effort) over months to years with **dry cough** (non productive) and fatigue. **Weight loss** and loss of appetite occur in advanced disease. Signs include **fine end inspiratory crackles** (Velcro, shawl effect), **clubbing**, **cyanosis** and **loud pulmonary component** of second heart sound when pulmonary hypertension appears. **Obstructive features** (wheeze, foul sputum) are atypical and suggest alternative disease. **Erythema nodosum** points to sarcoidosis, not IPF.
steps.say: Patients describe progressive exertional dyspnoea over months to years and it is hallmark. Dry cough is non productive and it is persistent. Weight loss and fatigue are common in advanced disease. Signs include fine end inspiratory crackles and clubbing and they are classic. Cyanosis and loud pulmonary component appear when pulmonary hypertension develops. Obstructive features are atypical and they suggest alternative disease. Erythema nodosum points to sarcoidosis and not to fibrosis.

steps.tx: **Pulmonary function tests** (PFT, spirometry plus volumes) show **restrictive pattern** (reduced forced vital capacity, preserved ratio, reduced total lung capacity). **Diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide** (DLCO, gas transfer) is markedly reduced and it is the most sensitive test. **High resolution computed tomography** (HRCT chest, thin section) is the key investigation and shows subpleural honeycombing, ground glass and traction bronchiectasis. **Bronchoalveolar lavage** (BAL, fluid wash) excludes infection and eosinophilic disease. **Surgical lung biopsy** (open or video assisted) is gold standard in uncertain cases.
steps.say: Pulmonary function tests show a restrictive pattern and it is classic. Forced vital capacity is reduced while the ratio is preserved. Diffusing capacity is markedly reduced and it is the most sensitive test. High resolution CT is the key investigation and it shows honeycombing and ground glass. Bronchoalveolar lavage is a test and it excludes infection and eosinophilic disease. Surgical lung biopsy is the gold standard in uncertain cases and it is diagnostic.

steps.tx: **Corticosteroids** (prednisolone 0.5 mg/kg daily) remain first line for **non specific interstitial pneumonia** and **organising pneumonia**. **Nintedanib** (150 mg twice daily) and **pirfenidone** (801 mg thrice daily) slow **forced vital capacity** decline in IPF. **Immunosuppression** (mycophenolate, rituximab) is used when connective tissue disease drives ILD. **Oxygen therapy** (home oxygen above 92%) corrects hypoxaemia. **Smoking cessation** is mandatory.
steps.say: Corticosteroids are first line for non specific and organising pneumonia and they are effective. Prednisolone dose is zero point five milligrams per kilogram daily. Nintedanib and pirfenidone slow forced vital capacity decline in fibrosis and they are recommended. Immunosuppression is used when connective tissue disease drives lung disease. Oxygen therapy corrects hypoxaemia when saturation is below ninety two percent. Smoking cessation is mandatory and it improves outcomes.

steps.tx: **ATS ERS 2022 guidelines** (American Thoracic Society, European Respiratory Society) endorse early **multidisciplinary discussion** (MDD, pulmonologist plus radiologist plus pathologist) for ILD diagnosis. **Antifibrotic therapy** is now early in progressive fibrosis, not delayed until advanced. **Acid suppression** (proton pump inhibitor) is not routine for IPF and is limited. **Pulmonary rehabilitation** (exercise, education) improves dyspnoea. **Lung transplantation** is the only curative option for end stage fibrosis and is debated early. **Screening** for lung cancer is debated in IPF.
steps.say: ATS ERS twenty twenty two guidelines are the standard and they endorse multidisciplinary discussion. Multidisciplinary discussion is pulmonologist plus radiologist plus pathologist and it is optimal. Antifibrotic therapy is now early in progressive fibrosis and it is recommended. Acid suppression is not routine and it is limited to selected patients. Pulmonary rehabilitation improves dyspnoea and quality of life. Lung transplantation is the only curative option for end stage fibrosis.

steps.tx: Complications include **acute exacerbation** (sudden worsening over days with new infiltrate) that is often fatal. **Pulmonary hypertension** (raised pulmonary pressure) causes right heart failure and worsens prognosis. **Lung cancer** (especially adenocarcinoma) risk is higher in IPF. **Cor pulmonale** (right ventricular failure) and **respiratory failure** drive mortality. Median survival in IPF is 3 to 5 years from diagnosis, worse than many cancers. **Pneumothorax** can occur with honeycombing. **Weight loss** and frailty accelerate decline.
steps.say: Complications include acute exacerbation and it is sudden worsening with new infiltrate. Acute exacerbation is often fatal and it needs urgent care. Pulmonary hypertension causes right heart failure and it worsens prognosis. Lung cancer risk is higher in fibrosis and surveillance is needed. Cor pulmonale is right ventricular failure and it drives mortality with respiratory failure. Median survival in fibrosis is three to five years from diagnosis. Pneumothorax can occur with honeycombing and it is serious.

steps.tx: Examiners contrast **IPF** (bibasal Velcro crackles, clubbing, subpleural honeycombing, poor steroid response) with **sarcoidosis** (hilar nodes, upper lobe perilymphatic nodules, good steroid response). **Hypersensitivity pneumonitis** (bird fancier lung, ground glass, mosaic attenuation) improves with antigen avoidance. **Eosinophilic pneumonia** (eosinophils above 25% in lavage) mimics infection but responds to steroids. **Drug induced ILD** (amiodarone, nitrofurantoin, bleomycin) is reversible if drug is stopped and is tested.
steps.say: Examiners contrast idiopathic fibrosis with sarcoidosis and it is important. Idiopathic fibrosis has bibasal crackles and honeycombing and it responds poorly to steroids. Sarcoidosis has hilar nodes and perilymphatic nodules and it responds well to steroids. Hypersensitivity pneumonitis improves with antigen avoidance and it is exposure related. Eosinophilic pneumonia is a mimic and it responds to steroids. Drug induced disease is reversible if the drug is stopped and it is tested.

steps.tx: **Inhaled exposures** (birds, mould, asbestos, silica, farm dust) must be detailed in every ILD case for **hypersensitivity pneumonitis** (immune alveolitis). **Connective tissue disease serology** (rheumatoid factor, anti nuclear antibody, anti Ro) identifies systemic cause. **Gastro oesophageal reflux** worsens IPF by microaspiration and needs treatment. **Obstructive sleep apnoea** is common in IPF and needs screening. **Vaccination** (influenza, pneumococcal, coronavirus) is recommended as steroids are used. **Early smoking cessation** prevents further injury.
steps.say: Inhaled exposures must be detailed in every case and they are important. Birds, mould, asbestos, silica and farm dust are common causes. Connective tissue disease serology identifies systemic cause and it is essential. Gastro oesophageal reflux worsens fibrosis by microaspiration. Obstructive sleep apnoea is common and it needs screening. Vaccination is recommended as steroids are used. Early smoking cessation prevents further injury and it is mandatory.

steps.tx: High yield patterns are restrictive physiology, markedly reduced DLCO, HRCT honeycombing and Velcro crackles with clubbing. Remember IPF antifibrotics, NSIP steroids and MDD for diagnosis. **UIP** is IPF pattern, **NSIP** is connective tissue pattern and **OP** is migratory. Surgical biopsy is gold standard when HRCT is uncertain. A quick table below collects patterns, tests, drugs and gold standards for revision.
steps.say: High yield patterns include restrictive physiology, reduced diffusing capacity, honeycombing and Velcro crackles with clubbing. Clinicians should remember antifibrotics for fibrosis and steroids for non specific pattern. Multidisciplinary discussion is standard for diagnosis. Usual pattern is fibrosis, non specific is connective tissue and organising is migratory. Surgical biopsy is gold standard when CT is uncertain.
